name: MonarchLineChart
title: LineChart
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas (DrawScope.drawPath, drawLine, drawCircle and drawText) with pointerInput tap and horizontal drag gestures; inside MonarchChartFrame with MonarchChartLegend and MonarchChartTable; axis ticks and scale from the MonarchBarChart core
summary: A line or area chart for trends over ordered categories or dates, with several series, gaps, reference lines, touch inspection, legend toggles and a data table.
whenToUse: For a trend over time or another ordered axis, such as sessions per day or latency per hour, with one to five series.
whenNotToUse: To compare separate categories, use MonarchBarChart; for parts of a whole, MonarchDonutChart or MonarchStackedProportionBar; for a word-sized trend inside text or a table cell, MonarchSparkline.

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name: the frame heading and the plot's spoken name.

options.name: categories
options.description: The x values in order, already localised. Spaced evenly.

options.name: dates
options.description: The x values in order, as epoch milliseconds in UTC. Spaced by time, so uneven dates show.

options.name: series
options.description: The measures: key, label, one value per x value (null or not finite is a gap), an optional color slot and dashed.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the frame.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title: the period, the unit or the question it answers.

options.name: xTitle
options.description: The heading of the x column of the data table.

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated spoken summary.

options.name: variant
options.description: Line, or Area: the line with a soft fill down to the baseline.

options.name: curve
options.description: Linear, or Monotone: smooth without overshooting the values.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Loading, Empty or Error, passed to the frame. Ready without x values or series shows Empty.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The keys of hidden series. null lets the chart keep its own set, changed by the legend.

options.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
options.description: Called with the new hidden set when the legend changes it.

options.name: activeIndex
options.description: The inspected x value, used when onActiveIndexChange is set. Give several charts on the same x values one state to share the crosshair. An index outside the x values is ignored.

options.name: onActiveIndexChange
options.description: Makes the inspection controlled: called with the index the user inspects, or null when it is cleared. null keeps the inspection inside the chart.

options.name: referenceLines
options.description: Dashed horizontal lines with a value and a label: targets, baselines, service levels.

options.name: valueRange
options.description: Fixes the value axis, such as 0.0..100.0 for percentages.

options.name: includeZero
options.description: Whether the value axis keeps zero. Turn it off for values far from zero.

options.name: showPoints
options.description: A dot on every value. Lone values between gaps always get one.

options.name: legendToggle
options.description: Whether legend entries show and hide their series. The legend appears with two or more series.

options.name: tableToggle
options.description: Whether "View as table" is offered.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the frame's empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart: the source, the last update.

options.name: height
options.description: The plot height, kept in every status.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Category, Date, No data, Details, Clear and the frame's strings; frame.noValue is also the text of a gap.

options.name: formatDate
options.description: Writes a date on the axis, in the inspection row, TalkBack, the table and the summary. The abbreviated month and day in the current locale, in UTC, by default.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes values in the inspection row, TalkBack, the table, the summary and on the axis. A number in the current locale (compact on the axis) by default.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Drill-in: called with the x index from Details in the inspection row or from the TalkBack action of that x value.

states.name: default
states.description: One line per shown series in its color slot, over subtle gridlines with value labels at the start edge and x labels under the plot; dashed series have a dashed line.

states.name: inspecting
states.description: After a tap or during a drag, or while activeIndex is set: a vertical crosshair in the strong border color, a larger ringed dot on each shown series and a row under the plot with the x value and every shown series' value, plus Details (with onSelect) and Clear.

states.name: series hidden
states.description: The series leaves the plot and the value range; its legend entry reads Hidden; it stays in the data table.

states.name: gap
states.description: A missing value breaks the line; a lone value between gaps is a dot.

states.name: area
states.description: Each line has a fill of its own hue mixed towards the surface color, down to zero, or to the nearest end of the axis when zero is left out.

states.name: loading, empty, error
states.description: The frame's skeleton, empty state or error with Try again, at the chart's height.

states.name: table
states.description: "View as table" swaps the plot for the data table, one row per x value.

appearance: Lines are 2dp in the theme's data colors 1 to 5 in series order, Neutral in the subtle text color; the area fill is the series color mixed 80% towards the surface color, opaque. Gridlines use the subtle border color, the zero line and crosshair the strong border color, axis labels the muted text color and reference lines the subtle text color. Every color is a theme role or a mix of two roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Drawn with a Compose Canvas (iOS uses Swift Charts, the web SVG); Android has no first-party chart library and Monarch adds none. The value axis, ticks and scale are the MonarchBarChart core, so the two charts read alike. The web xScale option is the choice of overload: categories are spaced evenly, dates (epoch milliseconds, UTC) by time; the web's numeric x values are not offered. Inspection follows MonarchBarChart rather than iOS: the tap or drag keeps the inspected point after the finger lifts, and its values are shown in a row under the plot with Details and Clear instead of a floating tooltip, so they are announced as a polite live region and can be read at large font sizes. As on the web, the activeIndex is controlled only through onActiveIndexChange, because Kotlin cannot tell an unset value from null. onSelect is the web onPointSelect and is offered here (iOS does not). The area fill is an opaque mix of the series color and the surface color instead of the web's transparent fill, because Monarch never dims with alpha. There is no keyboard arrow navigation of points: TalkBack users swipe through one element per x value. The web formatTick option is formatValue. The frame's header actions slot is not offered.
accessibility: The plot is one element with the image role, named by the title, whose state description is the generated summary ("5 points, Mon to Fri. This week: low 820, high 1,330, latest 1,330. Target 1,200") or the summary parameter.

After it, one element per x value in order (traversal index), placed over that point's strip of the plot and read as the x value and each shown series' value ("Mon: This week 820, Last week 700"); a gap is read as "No value".
With onSelect each x value element has a custom action "Details, Mon"; without it, the elements have no action.
The values of an inspected point are shown under the plot in a polite live region, with Details and Clear buttons that keep a 48dp touch target.
Series differ by their names in the legend and, where dashed is set, by a dashed line and marker, not by color alone.
Legend entries are toggles named by the series, with Hidden as their state while hidden; the last shown series cannot be hidden.
"View as table" shows every value as text; each row is read as the x value then every series and its value.
edgeCases: null and non-finite values are gaps, never zero; a series shorter than the x values ends in gaps and extra values are ignored.
A ready chart without x values or without series shows the empty state.
A single series has no legend; the title names it.
With includeZero off and no valueRange, the axis fits the values and a flat series is padded by a tenth of its value; the area fills down to the bottom of the axis.
Reference lines are part of the value range, so a target far above the data stays visible.
X labels thin out to keep their width apart, always keeping the first and the last; long labels are cut with an ellipsis.
Duplicate categories are separate points; equal dates share one position.
Touch inspection and the point elements were checked with Robolectric semantics and touch tests, not with TalkBack on a device.

examples.webExample: Two series with a previous period and a target

examples.title: Area with gaps over dates
examples.code:
MonarchLineChart(
    title = "p95 latency",
    dates = (0..6).map { march1 + it * day },
    series = listOf(
        MonarchLineChartSeries("p95", "p95", listOf(210.0, 220.0, null, 260.0, 240.0, null, 235.0)),
    ),
    variant = MonarchLineChartVariant.Area,
    curve = MonarchLineChartCurve.Monotone,
    includeZero = false,
    height = 180.dp,
    formatValue = { "${it.toInt()} ms" },
)

examples.title: Two charts sharing one crosshair
examples.setup:
var active by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<Int?>(2) }
val weeks = listOf("W1", "W2", "W3", "W4")
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchLineChart(
        title = "Sessions",
        categories = weeks,
        series = listOf(MonarchLineChartSeries("sessions", "Sessions", listOf(820.0, 932.0, 901.0, 1290.0))),
        activeIndex = active,
        onActiveIndexChange = { active = it },
        height = 140.dp,
    )
    MonarchLineChart(
        title = "Sign-ups",
        categories = weeks,
        series = listOf(
            MonarchLineChartSeries("signups", "Sign-ups", listOf(42.0, 51.0, 47.0, 88.0), MonarchChartColor.Data2),
        ),
        activeIndex = active,
        onActiveIndexChange = { active = it },
        height = 140.dp,
    )
}

examples.title: Loading and error states
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchLineChart(
        title = "Sessions",
        categories = emptyList(),
        series = emptyList(),
        status = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Loading,
    )
    MonarchLineChart(
        title = "Sessions",
        categories = emptyList(),
        series = emptyList(),
        status = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Error,
        onRetry = { attempts += 1 },
    )
}

parityExceptions.reason: The reference line label "Target 1.2K" is drawn on the chart canvas, where the preview shows it, and is not a separate node for TalkBack; the spoken summary reads the reference line with its value.
parityExceptions.convention: chart labels are canvas drawing with a summary description and a table alternative (Material charts guidance)
